narrator.label: Narrator
narrator.description: An articulate adult English narrator with warm authority and a thoughtful, varied cadence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Coherence Pressure proposes a name for the pull to connect things before the evidence is there.

direction.delivery: Explain the proposed idea in a warm, ordinary voice; emphasize the concrete choice the listener can inspect, without announcing a proven breakthrough.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It begins with a child who wants an unwanted app removed but keeps watching short videos.

direction.delivery: Explain the proposed idea in a warm, ordinary voice; emphasize the concrete choice the listener can inspect, without announcing a proven breakthrough.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A model finds a way to connect the two through attention and choice.

direction.delivery: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “connect the two”. Keep the thought easy to follow; no grand or solemn delivery.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The explanation sounds good, but a shared vocabulary does not show that the same cause is at work.

direction.delivery: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “does not show”. Keep the thought easy to follow; no grand or solemn delivery.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book examines how convincing connections can appear before anyone has tested them.

direction.delivery: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “before anyone has tested them”. Let concern come from the situation; no alarm or dramatic drop in pitch.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It also puts its own proposed explanation under the same scrutiny.

direction.delivery: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “its own proposed explanation”. Keep the thought easy to follow; no grand or solemn delivery.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: For people who think and write with AI, the original conversation makes the problem easy to recognize.

direction.delivery: Natural and precise; give light emphasis to “original conversation”. Keep the thought easy to follow; no grand or solemn delivery.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: What would you need to check before letting a beautiful explanation settle the question?

direction.delivery: Warm, unhurried closing; give light emphasis to “what would you need to check”. Keep the thought easy to follow; no grand or solemn delivery.
